title: ARIA configuration
description: aria.config.json at the root of a repository orchestrated by ARIA. lib/config.mjs is the validator the engine runs; this schema describes the same rules for editors and documentation, and the tests keep the two in step. One rule is checked only by the loader: an impact rule must name an agent declared in "agents".

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema, for editor support. Ignored by ARIA.

agents.description: The project's agents, by name. Each write agent owns a territory of paths; read-only agents audit and own none.

impactRules.description: Reviews that a change touching the matched paths requires or recommends. The plugin's own bootstrap rule is fixed in code and cannot be removed here.

dir.description: Folder holding one directory per spec.

generatedInputs.description: Generated files that a task may read as input, so evidence counts them even when they are git-ignored.

externalResources.description: Resource prefixes whose exclusive use a local lock cannot prove (a database branch, a deploy target). Added to the fixed prefixes "external" and "ci".

locale.description: Language of the approval label and the questions ARIA asks.

category.description: Free-form group, e.g. implementation, test, audit.

allowedPaths.description: Globs the agent may write. A leading ! excludes a path. Must be empty for a read-only agent.

defaultVerification.description: Commands that verify the agent's tasks when a task declares none.

rule.description: Name shown as the reason for the review.

containedPath.description: A relative path inside the repository: not absolute, no .. segment.
